# Reference Position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ReferencePosition`](gmeow-ReferencePosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ReferencePosition>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

The spatial locus, observatory, timezone, or planetary body relative to which a time is expressed — e.g. an observatory longitude for local sidereal time, an IANA timezone for civil time, or a planet for planetary calendars.

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)
